comments: Inclusense Accessibility Scanner is the automated evaluation component of the Inclusense platform, built on axe-core. It crawls a site, lets users select pages, and reports WCAG-tagged issues with severity and an overall score. (Note: our separate accessibility widget is a remediation tool and is intentionally not part of this submission.)
features: Inclusense is an automated web accessibility evaluation tool. Powered by axe-core, it crawls a website, lets you choose which pages to test, and audits them against WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2. It returns an accessibility score, severity-ranked issues tagged by WCAG success criterion, and shareable PDF reports to help teams prioritize fixes.
title: Inclusense Accessibility Scanner
